2608.24771.title: Ensemble of Convolutional Neural Networks for StrokePrediction: Towards Improved Diagnostic Accuracy
2608.24771.paper_summary: Brain stroke, known for its high mortality and incidence rates, poses significant health risks and requires rapid intervention for survival. Early diagnosis and preventive measures can greatly reduce life loss and disabilities. Recent advancements in deep learning have led to novel computer-aided diagnostic techniques for early stroke detection. This study proposes an intelligent system that predicts potential strokes using eleven features, evaluated through seven supervised machine learning algorithms. The process includes a literature review, dataset visualization, data preprocessing, and model evaluation. Ensemble methods like Random Forest, Stacking Classifier, and Bagging Classifier achieved high accuracies of 99.52%, while Decision Tree reached 98.24%. Other models, including KNN and TabNet, demonstrated reliable performance, achieving accuracies of 96.73% and 96.49%, respectively. The custom feedforward model achieved 94.91%, while SVC and logistic regression had lower accuracies at 88.06% and 77.03%. The results highlight the effectiveness of ensemble methods in stroke classification.
2608.24771.paper_summary_zh: 腦中風以其高死亡率和發病率而聞名，對健康構成重大風險，並需要迅速干預以確保生存。早期診斷和預防措施可以大幅減少生命損失和殘疾。近期深度學習的進展導致了新型的計算機輔助診斷技術，用於早期中風檢測。本研究提出了一個智能系統，利用十一個特徵預測潛在的中風，並通過七種監督式機器學習算法進行評估。該過程包括文獻回顧、數據集可視化、數據預處理和模型評估。隨機森林、堆疊分類器和袋裝分類器等集成方法達到了99.52%的高準確率，而決策樹則達到了98.24%。其他模型，包括KNN和TabNet，顯示出可靠的性能，分別達到96.73%和96.49%的準確率。自定義前饋模型達到了94.91%，而SVC和邏輯回歸的準確率較低，分別為88.06%和77.03%。結果突顯了集成方法在中風分類中的有效性。
